rules.outdoor: outdoor_seating contains one of yes, parklet, pedestrian_zone, street, sidewalk, patio, terrace, balcony, veranda, roof, garden, beach, courtyard, separate
rules.homestay: tourism=homestay, homestay=yes, or lodging with the word homestay in an OSM name tag
rules.districts: Explicit addr:district labels with Quận, Huyện or Thành phố (including TP.). District N and Quan N normalize to Quận N; the top-level HCM label is excluded.
